spans.s:
√mṛj (mā́rṣṭi [627]; mamā́rja; ámārjīt,
ámārkṣīt; mārkṣyáte; mṛṣṭá; mā́rṣṭum;
mṛṣṭvā́; -mṛ́jya; also mā́rjitum, mārjitvā́,
-mā́rjya). rub off; wipe away;
clean; polish.
[original meaning ‘move hither and
thither over’: then, on the one hand,
 —1. ‘range, rove, streifen,’ as in Avestan
mĕrĕgh, and Skt. mṛga; and, on the one hand,
other,
 —2. ‘go over with the hand, i. e.
rub, wipe, strip (a tree, a cow), milk’:
for 2, cf. ὀ-μόργ-νυμι, ‘wipe off’; ἀ-μέργ-ω,
‘strip off, pluck’; ἀ-μέλγ-ειν, Lat. mulgēre,
‘to milk’; AS. noun meolc, Eng.
milk.]
+ apa, wipe away; also fig., of guilt.
[cf. ἀπομόργνυμι, ‘wipe away.’]
+ pra, wipe off, polish.
